answer_4.guideline: The raters achieved an agreement score of 0.30 with Distil-RoBERTa and an agreement score of 0.41 among themselves. To further clarify our results, we manually examined the raters' labels and discovered that around 68% of them assigned two or more negative emotions to the same tweet.
